gallery.description:
We spent three weeks in Madagascar. From 'Tana we  went to Berenty, then Fort Dauphin. Ranomaphana, Isalo N/P, Tulear, Anakoa, Ifaty, Ampijoroa, Andasibe, and finally Perinet and Mantadia N/P.
It remains for me The most unusual and fascinating place we have travelled to.

Much of their flora and fauna remains unique but is disappearing fast.

So go there if you possibly can, you will love it.
